camera_spec.motion_distribution: camera endpoints and average speeds are clipped Gaussian samples; per-frame motion follows the stored speed_curve, so most moving trajectories have within-clip speed variation
camera_spec.speed_sampling_note: brisk samples are capped around 1.5x the baseline camera-motion scale

physics_spec.description: A horizontal procedural capsule rolls and slides across the floor instead of standing upright.
physics_spec.sample_model: capsule radius/depth, mass, velocity, angular velocity, friction, restitution, color, and material profile are clipped Gaussian samples.
